title: nan
authors: Peti M.; Marković L.; Lončar I.; Barišić Kulaš A.; Petric F.; Milas A.; Goričanec J.; Car M.; Orsag M.; Ferreira B.A.; Bogdan S.
key_contribution: Presents an aerial localization and navigation system for GNSS-denied maritime surveillance using LoRa localization and RGB camera with Kalman filtering, validated in a full mission field test.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
